description: Deliberately broken records. Each MUST fail validation with at least one error whose location or message contains 'expect'.

practitioner-with-name.json.reason: Observer Practitioner carries a name and an e-mail address

practitioner-email-as-code.json.reason: Observer identifier is an e-mail address instead of a random OBS-XXXXXX code

observation-without-subject.json.reason: Citizen finding without a subject site

dead-bird-with-diagnosis.json.reason: Dead bird report claims an infection result and an interpretation

dead-bird-without-disclaimer.json.reason: Dead bird report without the no-diagnosis note

servicerequest-code-not-in-valueset.json.reason: Action category code not in the AquaSentinel action category value set

servicerequest-without-requester.json.reason: Approved action without a requester (no officer approval recorded)

citizen-finding-status-amended.json.reason: Citizen finding status 'amended' is not allowed (preliminary or final only)

indicator-finding-preliminary.json.reason: Unpromoted (preliminary) finding claims the OAH indicator profile, which fixes status final

provenance-without-reliability.json.reason: Observer Provenance without the observer reliability extension

indicator-finding-health-code.json.reason: Citizen finding uses an OAH human health code (disease prevalence), outside the codes AquaSentinel may use

bundle-with-named-observer.json.reason: Transaction Bundle whose observer Practitioner entry carries a name (entries are validated against their profiles)
